fa587d22e173.visual: A brick building with a steeply pitched green tiled roof and a peaked gable over the entrance, wooden double doors reached by a short flight of concrete steps with metal railings. fa61848404b0.visual: A brick building with arched windows and a wreathed doorway on the lower level and a row of rectangular windows above, under a red tile roof with wide eaves; vines climb one corner, and a bench sits near a frost-patched walkway leading to the entrance.

fa88976156f3.visual: Red-brick building with a white-columned entrance portico, blue doors and windows, clipped hedges in front, power lines overhead against clear blue sky.

fafc8cd6f369.visual: Red brick building with a pitched gable wing on the left, tall multi-paned windows arranged in rows, and a chain-link fence across the front, set in a snowy winter landscape.

fb1a1f6456cc.visual: A rounded corner tower with a domed, red-tiled roof anchors a fieldstone building with a smaller peaked roof extending to one side, where a stone archway frames the entrance above a set of steps with railings. fb2273b80db1.visual: A pale stone library building with a distinctive gabled pediment and six large arched windows with dark frames. “Westport Public Library” and the date “1856” are carved on the façade.

fb6a1d283773.visual: A brick building with a raised central entrance framed by tall columns and a triangular pediment above, arched doorways reached by short flights of steps with metal railings, an American flag on a pole out front, snow on the ground and bare trees to the side under a clear sky.

fb709ce52579.visual: Red brick building with pitched tiled roof and symmetrical facade. Stone-trimmed arched entrance with double doors flanked by paired sash windows; circular window above. Bordered by shrubs and concrete path.

fb88be9a6321.visual: Cream-brick neoclassical building with paired stone columns and tall arched windows. Ivy cascades the left wall; a colourful banner decorates the entrance. Metal transmission tower visible in clear blue sky behind.

fba1591d6e77.visual: Red brick and cream stone building with a pitched roof and arched ground-floor windows. A brick pathway with wooden railings approaches a central portico between bare trees.

fbc68cb5457f.visual: A brick building with a wide overhanging roof, a row of tall windows with dark green frames, and a green door under a “PUBLIC LIBRARY” sign; a taller brick section with its own green-framed entrance sits to the left. Snow covers the roof and ground, with a street lamp and bare trees nearby.

fbdb57ec27e9.visual: A stone building with a triangular pediment over a columned entrance, flanked by wide rows of windows and reached by a broad set of steps and a straight walkway. Two lamp posts stand along the path, with trees and shrubs on either side of the lawn.

fbf673f71603.visual: A brick building with a projecting entrance porch under a gabled roof, “PUBLIC LIBRARY” carved into a stone panel above double wooden doors reached by a short flight of concrete steps. Shrubs with deep red foliage flank the entrance, a lawn with patches of snow and fallen leaves surrounds it under an overcast sky.

fc00942ba998.visual: A library interior with arched dark wooden beams supporting a ribbed ceiling, lit by pendant lamps with white shades. Large multi-paned windows and walls lined with bookshelves frame the space below.

fc1701364ea7.visual: A tan brick building with a stone entrance framed by columns, an oval carved panel above the wood-and-glass door, and tall windows along the side, reached by a curving stone staircase with a metal handrail, grass and weeds growing at the base.

fc2adc082641.visual: Red brick building with large arched windows topped by semicircular fan lights. A central arched doorway sits beneath a triangular pediment, with an American flag on a pole in front and dense green foliage surrounding the structure.

fc8beac89052.visual: A single-story building with brick and pale stone banding, tall windows with white frames, and a hipped roof with wide overhanging eaves. fca68bee2ee1.visual: A red brick building with a stone base and large arched windows, set back behind mature trees and a grass verge. Steps lead up to a central entrance.

fcd672443e2f.visual: Pale stone building with fluted columns at a street corner, featuring a large arched window on the curved facade. Mature trees flank either side; a parked car sits in front under partly cloudy sky.

fd095781563b.visual: A tan brick corner building with a dark red painted base, “CARNEGIE LIBRARY” lettered on a sign above the entrance columns, rows of windows with dark trim along both street-facing sides, a decorative arched cornice, parked cars and an evergreen tree at the curb.

fd5691c7c91d.visual: A single-story building with pale brick walls and a red tiled hipped roof, its facade lined with tall arched windows. Flagpoles and evergreen trees stand in front, with a taller pale high-rise building behind, under an overcast sky.

fd5ad8b8630c.visual: A pale stone building with a steep red tiled roof and gabled ends, a dark wooden door reached by a short flight of steps flanked by lamp posts, tall multi-pane windows and shrubs and small trees along the grassy front, under an overcast sky.

fd7cac91111c.visual: A brick building with a classical white stone front, two columns supporting a pediment inscribed “Public Library”. The entrance door sits beneath an arched window, framed by green trees.

fe146281f0e0.visual: A pale stone facade with three tall arched windows on the middle floor flanked by rectangular ones, and three arched windows above a rusticated ground floor with two arched black doors framed by lantern sconces. fe51037a50d2.visual: A single-story brick building with a broad pitched roof, a central entrance flanked by wide windows with dark trim, and a stone panel reading “CARNEGIE LIBRARY” above the door. Concrete steps lead up between low stone piers, and the lower windows are boarded over.

fe7f80dc37e8.visual: A brick building with white stone trim sits behind tall trees, its columned entrance reached by a short flight of steps, tall windows lining the side, and a house visible beyond it.

fe845e72eff3.visual: A three-storey red-brick building with alternating stone bands and a prominent domed roof. Four arched windows on the ground floor, rectangular sash windows with dark railings above, and climbing plants on the right side.

fe8b17e1c9ba.visual: Red brick building with pitched roof, tall windows and a modern glass extension on the right. Ivy clothes the left wall; hedging and mature trees frame the landscaped setting.

febd790db315.visual: A white octagonal roof lantern rises above red-brick masonry, topped with a black cap and a tall white pole crowned by a metal finial, against clear blue sky.

fedd327a16a6.visual: A brick and stone building with a triangular pediment over a columned entrance, lettering carved across the entablature, reached by a wide flight of steps flanked by two globe lamps, with tall shaded windows and tree branches overhanging the facade against a clear blue sky.

fee59105fe3b.visual: Pale stone single-storey building with a classical columned entrance and row of tall windows. An antenna extends from the flat roof above a paved forecourt.

fef683166cde.visual: A red brick building with pale stone trim at the corners, a pediment reading “MEMORIAL LIBRARY” over the entrance, and a domed roof section behind it. ff041d678e55.visual: Light-colored stone facade with a central arched entrance framed by columns, a lettered sign reading “HAGEDORN” above white double doors, flanked by tall windows, with wide stone steps and metal railings leading up to it.
